source_title: New Official Minecraft Release Confirmed for October 27 - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Minecraft fans have a brand-new release to look forward to on October 27, opening the game up to an all-new audience. Best of all, some existing Minecraft players will have the opportunity to get this release for free, given they meet one important condition.
Almost 15 years after its full release, Minecraft remains a cultural giant. The game has been re-released across numerous platforms, drawing in new players year after year. There has been no shortage of Minecraft -inspired games over the years, but few have been able to maintain relevance like the original. It has done this through constant updates each year, always ensuring that even the most experienced of players have new content to enjoy.
Minecraft Switch 2 Upgrade Drops October 27
Minecraft 's Nintendo Switch 2 upgrade officially drops on October 27, bringing Mojang's sandbox game to Nintendo's latest console natively for the first time. The upgrade comes with the Vibrant Visuals update, making Minecraft more beautiful than ever. This also means players have access to Vibrant Visuals-enabled content in the marketplace. It also includes the Super Mario Mash-Up pack, featuring 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the Super Mario franchise.
Find the odd one out before the timer hits zero.
It was previously confirmed that the Nintendo Switch 2 version of Minecraft will be a free upgrade , but only for some users. To qualify, a gamer must have owned a digital version of Minecraft on the Nintendo Switch, meaning those who purchased a physical copy will need to buy the game again at full price. The free upgrade is only available until the end of January 2027, so gamers who want to upgrade should act fast to get their copy at no cost. To buy the Nintendo Switch 2 version, it costs $29.99.

While most veteran gamers have almost certainly tried Minecraft over the years, it's good to see Mojang continuing to port the game to new platforms. Part of its incredible longevity is how it has captured the imagination of new gamers playing for the first time and converted them into long-time players. And the popularity of the Nintendo Switch 2 means this new Minecraft release has the opportunity to appeal to some who may never have played the game before.
Despite the age of the game, some of Minecraft 's biggest updates are yet to come. Next year, Minecraft is getting a brand-new dimension named the Sift, the first in 14 years. Mojang is also releasing a new biome, Ice Caves, in a game drop later this year, meaning fans have plenty to look forward in the near future.
